svg.text: Raspberry Pi → 74HCT541 level shifters (3.3 V in, 5 V out, not inverting) → Mobitec 26-pin panel header
Pin numbers are the physical pins of each connector and chip. Every chip gets a 100 nF capacitor from pin 20 to pin 10, close to the chip.
Panel pin 3 (5 V for the panel's logic)
D1 blocks a reversed plug; C4 buffers the current of the coil pulses.
